summary: Completed testing of Payment Gateway integration (Stripe & PayPal). All 16 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend PaymentPage and PayPalSimulatePage working correctly with full payment flows.
critical_code_review_comments: Payment endpoints properly validate package_id before processing
Stripe checkout creates real checkout sessions with valid URLs
PayPal is correctly implemented in TEST/SIMULATION mode - not calling real PayPal API
Payment transactions are properly stored in MongoDB with all required fields
PayPal capture endpoint handles already_captured status correctly
Frontend PaymentPage displays all 15 packages (3 plans x 5 durations) with correct pricing
PayPal 'Test Mode' badge is clearly visible to users
seed_data_creation: None - used existing packages defined in backend
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment gateway fully tested. Routes: /payment (PaymentPage) and /payment/paypal-simulate (PayPalSimulatePage). Backend endpoints: GET /api/payments/packages (15 packages), GET /api/payments/payment-methods (Stripe + PayPal), POST /api/payments/create-checkout (Stripe), POST /api/payments/paypal/create-checkout, POST /api/payments/paypal/capture/{order_id}. PayPal is in TEST MODE - simulates payment flow without real PayPal API calls.

GET /api/payments/payment-methods.details: Returns Stripe and PayPal methods, PayPal has test_mode=true

POST /api/payments/create-checkout.details: Creates Stripe checkout session with valid checkout.stripe.com URL

POST /api/payments/paypal/create-checkou.details: Creates PayPal order with PP- prefixed order_id and simulation approval URL

POST /api/payments/paypal/capture/{order.details: Captures payment, handles already_captured, returns 404 for non-existent orders

GET /api/payments/transactions.details: Returns transaction list, supports company_id filter

features: Each plan has 5 duration options with USD and EGP pricing
Redirects to Stripe checkout when Stripe selected
Redirects to PayPal simulation when PayPal selected
Shows PayPal branding with Test Mode badge
Shows Order ID, Package, and Amount
Cancel and Confirm Payment buttons work
Shows Payment Successful screen after confirmation
Go to Dashboard button available after success

stripe_flow.details: Select package -> Select Credit Card -> Proceed -> Redirects to checkout.stripe.com

paypal_flow.details: Select package -> Select PayPal -> Proceed -> PayPal Simulate page -> Confirm -> Success

mocked_apis_list: PayPal integration is in TEST/SIMULATION mode - does not call real PayPal API
PayPal approval_url redirects to /payment/paypal-simulate instead of paypal.com
mocked_apis.note: Stripe uses real test key (sk_test_emergent) and creates real checkout sessions
